notes:
FixLags for Windows 0.11.0 (beta): ready for several relay locations.

- Servers → FixLags relay: FixLags measures the ping from your PC to every FixLags relay and uses the one with the lowest ping ("Automatic", the default). You can also pick a relay yourself.
- Automatic keeps your current relay unless another one is clearly faster (at least 10 ms and 15 %), so it does not jump between similar relays.
- A relay is never changed during a connection: FixLags sets up access on the new relay in the background and switches when you are disconnected and the new relay is ready.
- Relays are measured at start, every 10 minutes and with "Measure again", never while connected.

Right now there is one relay (Frankfurt); new locations show up in the app by themselves when they open.

Known limitations: IPv4 only; the installer is not Authenticode-signed yet (Windows SmartScreen warns); administrator rights are needed at install and at every start; FixLags cannot guarantee a lower ping and shows measured results only.
